The Lantern Room

[Verse 1]
Leave a light in the window,
Let the late-night records spin.
Every road returns to somewhere,
Every stranger can come in.

[Chorus]
Underneath the silver signal,
Where the quiet voices glow,
We will keep a little lantern
For the ones still coming home.

[Instrumental interlude]

[Verse 2]
Fold the map beside the speaker,
Set the kettle on the flame.
When the last blue train is leaving,
We will call each other’s name.
